default.origin: SI-authored static vocabulary, short phrases and explicit typo pairs; materialized from the initial Chinese starter and 92 original fixtures

train/chat.csv.origin: SI-authored synthetic chat: original static collection plus 22,000 locally composed examples across 25 semantic families; see EXPANSION_50K.md

train/english.csv.origin: SI-authored synthetic English: original static collection plus 2,500 authored sentences with identity and space-removed input variants; see EXPANSION_50K.md

train/mixed.csv.origin: SI-authored synthetic mixed-language text: original static collection plus 3,000 examples preserving literal technical names and filenames; see EXPANSION_50K.md

train/typos.csv.origin: SI-authored synthetic spelling errors: original static collection plus 1,027 interior adjacent-transposition examples derived only from new training chat targets; see EXPANSION_50K.md
